language.string: The Hungarians bring the cavalry traditions of the Magyar people to the battlefield.
The Finns bring forest warfare and elite jaeger marksmen to the battlefield.
Light jaeger skirmisher with excellent range; very strong against heavy infantry, but fragile.
Finnish hybrid: builds structures, gathers wood, and fights as heavy infantry with a bonus against cavalry. Starts colonist-like in Age I and regains its military stats in Age II.
Hungarian infantry with a strong melee charge and bonus damage against skirmishers and heavy infantry. Does not gain rank promotions.
Hungarian line infantry armed with a needle gun. Good against cavalry and other infantry.
Upgrades Honvéds to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Honvéds to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Honvéds to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Hajduks to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Hajduks to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Hajduks to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack, +0.10 speed).
Elite Hungarian shock cavalry, powerful in melee.
Croatian cavalry: ranged attack strong vs cavalry (x3) and artillery (x2); melee strong vs infantry (x3).
Upgrades Magyar Hussars to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Magyar Hussars to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Crabats to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Crabats to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
The old obligation of the Hungarian nobility to provide cavalry allows a larger number of Magyar Hussars to be kept on the battlefield. Effect: Magyar Hussars now cost 2 population instead of 3.
+15% attack and hitpoints to Honvéds and Hajduks.
Hajduks adapt their defense to their combat stance: melee armor in melee mode, siege armor (vs artillery) in staggered mode, and ranged armor in normal mode.
Versatile mounted rifleman, effective against cavalry and at range.
Mounted infantry fighting on foot: a ranged skirmisher strong against heavy infantry. Can mount back onto its horse.
+15% attack and hitpoints to all cavalry.
+20% hitpoints and attack to heavy cavalry.
TEAM Ships 7 Pandours. Can be shipped infinitely in the Industrial Age.
Hungarian grenadier that hurls grenades; powerful against buildings and infantry. Trained and upgraded at the Artillery Foundry.
Upgrades Hungarian Grenadiers to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Hungarian Grenadiers to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Hungarian Grenadiers to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Hungarian AI: Honvéd infantry, Magyar hussars and artillery.
Finnish AI: forest jaegers, wood economy and light artillery.
Enables Crossbowmen training at the Barracks and their Veteran upgrade (researchable there).
Ships 1 Outpost Wagon and raises the maximum Outpost limit by +1. From then on, each of your own military shipments also includes 1 extra Outpost Wagon.
Permanently changes the cost of Hajduks (40 food, 70 coin) and Crabats (90 food, 90 coin).

Adds technologies to the Church that ship troops when researched: Crossbowmen and Pikemen (Age II), Uhlans and Janissaries (Age III, Janissaries can also be trained at the Barracks) and Great Bombards (Age IV).
Research at the Church for 500 wood to ship 10 Crossbowmen.
Research at the Church for 500 food to ship 10 Pikemen.
Research at the Church for 1000 food to ship 7 Uhlans.
Research at the Church for 2000 wood to ship 20 Janissaries and enable training them at the Barracks.
Research at the Church for 2000 coin to ship 3 Great Bombards.
Grants +50% hitpoints and attack to the Explorer, lets it heal and train Surgeons and Field Hospitals, and ships 1 Surgeon.

Adds technologies to the Church that ship troops when researched: Streltsy of Noteborg (Age II), Halberdiers of Viborg and Ingrian Recruits (Age III), and Cannon Shipment (Age IV). Also unlocks the Blockhouse Veteran/Guard/Imperial upgrades and the Northern Musketeers card (Age IV).
Research at the Church for 500 food to ship 13 Streltsy.
Research at the Church for 1000 coin to ship 14 Halberdiers.
Research at the Church for 1000 wood to ship 16 Rekruts (Russian musketeers).
Research at the Church for 500 food to ship 2 Leather Cannons and enable them as trainable at the Blockhouse from Age II.
Ships 2 Blockhouse Wagons and upgrades Blockhouses: +25% hitpoints, extra bounty, and +1 to their build limit.
Upgrades Karelian Jaegers to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Karelian Jaegers to Guard (+30% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Savolax Jaegers to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Karelian Jaegers to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Savolax Jaegers to Guard (+30% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Savolax Jaegers to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Counter Jaegers to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Counter Jaegers to Guard (+30% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Counter Jaegers to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Counter Dragoons to Guard (+20% hitpoints and attack).
Upgrades Counter Dragoons to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack).
Finland breaks away from Sweden: the Karelian Jaeger (Skirmisher) becomes a builder/gatherer with its real veteran look, trainable at the Town Center and the Blockhouse. The Settler is not lost.
Regains normal age advancement after the Revolution (Finland jumps straight to Age III). The Karelian Jaeger keeps its ability to build and gather.
Finland has returned to the path of progress!
Ships 3 Landsknechts and enables training them at the Barracks and the Fort.
Research at the Church to upgrade Streltsy, Halberdiers, Rekruts and Leather Cannons trained at the Blockhouse to Veteran (+20% hitpoints and attack). Requires Age III.
Upgrades Blockhouse units to Guard (+35% hitpoints and attack). Requires Blockhouse Veterancy and Age IV.
Upgrades Blockhouse units to Imperial (+50% hitpoints and attack). Requires Blockhouse Guard and Age V.
Research at the Church for 1000 coin to ship 25 Northern Musketeers and enable them as trainable at the Blockhouse, at the cost of disabling Streltsy and Rekruts.
Criollo lancer on a heavy mount.
Mounted grenadier armed with a musket.
The Argentinian AI: gauchos, criollos and grenadiers of the Pampas.
Removes the Janissary (and its upgrades) in exchange for removing the training limit on the Nizam.
Ships 4 Mamelukes to each ally for 1200 coin.
Frontier soldier of the Hungarian-Ottoman Militärgrenze. Versatile light infantry, strong against skirmish troops.
Upgrades Grenzer to Veteran (+20% hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Grenzer to Guard (+20% additional hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Grenzer to Imperial (+50% hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Irregular Croatian light infantry in Habsburg service. Tough, strong against skirmish troops.
Upgrades Pandur to Veteran (+20% hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Pandur to Guard (+20% additional hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Upgrades Pandur to Imperial (+50% hit points and damage, +0.10 speed).
Italian light skirmisher, available from the Colonial Age but weak (60% of its real stats); reaches full strength in the Industrial Age.
Irregular Romanian musket infantry. Replaces the Rekrut in the Blockhouse; trains in batches of 4.
Light cavalry archer. Available from Age III at 80% of its stats; reaches full strength in Age IV.
Elite Romanian dragoons. Visible in the Stable from the start, but only trainable from Age IV onward.
